entries.description: Read docs/planning/project-guidance.md and docs/planning/lessons-learned.md; read spec.md and verified the prerequisite pdf-info-metadata-api set is closed (change-log.md present).

Authored tests/DabblerPdf.Tests/Pdf/MultipageDirectContentRenderingTests.cs with five tests; confirmed 3 of them fail on the current (broken) PdfWriter: 3-logical-pages→2-physical; 7→6; physical page 1 text is 'MARKER_PAGE_1MARKER_PAGE_2'. The other 2 (SinglePage_NoExplicitNewPage, ExplicitNewPagePerPage) pass on broken code, guarding the non-regression contract. Test dependency: PdfPig 0.1.* (Apache-2.0, test-only, does not propagate to the DabblerPdf NuGet license expression).

Applied option (a) from spec Step 3: EndCurrentPage flushes whenever DirectContent.HasContent or a page has been started. Introduced _pageStarted tracker in PdfWriter to distinguish 'page open awaiting flush' from 'last page already flushed via EndCurrentPage' — needed so writer.Close does not double-flush an empty trailing page after the EndCurrentPage flush. Removed the _firstPage field (no longer a reliable signal once EndCurrentPage can flush on the first transition). In writer.Close, flush via _pageStarted path for the explicit-NewPage case, the has-content path for the Pattern-2 single-page-no-NewPage case, and the empty-pages path to preserve the ≥1-page guarantee. In Document.NewPage and Document.Close, bump _pageNumber from 0 to 1 when the implicit first page flushes so OnStartPage/OnEndPage fire at PageNumber == 1 as existing consumers expect. Exposed PdfContentByte.HasContent as an internal property.

The permanent regression test is MultipageDirectContentRenderingTests with 5 tests: (1) PdfExporterPattern_ProducesOnePhysicalPagePerLogicalPage — physical page count matches logical page count; (2) PdfExporterPattern_EachPhysicalPageTextIsIsolated — per-physical-page PdfPig text extraction shows only the intended marker; (3) PdfExporterPattern_SevenLogicalPages_ProducesSevenPhysicalPages — 7-page case mirroring the field incident; (4) SinglePageDirectContent_NoExplicitNewPage_ProducesOneValidPage — Pattern 2 guard; (5) ExplicitNewPagePerPagePattern_StillProducesOnePhysicalPagePerLogicalPage — MVP-scenario-1 shape guard. Every assertion goes through PdfPig's per-physical-page text extraction, not raw byte grep, per the lesson in lessons-learned.md ('String In Bytes' is not 'Rendered Visible').
